components.name: site-header
behaviors: Contains site logo and navigation toggle
Fixed positioning at top of page
Becomes hamburger menu on narrow viewports
keyboardExpectations: Tab moves focus to the skip link, then to the nav toggle, then into the navigation menu when open
Enter or Space on the nav toggle opens/closes the menu
Escape closes the open menu and returns focus to the toggle

components.name: site-logo
behaviors: Displays the fictional site name as text
Acts as a link to the home page
keyboardExpectations: Receives focus when navigating via Tab
Activates on Enter or Space to navigate to home

components.name: primary-nav
behaviors: Horizontal list of links on wide viewports
Collapses to vertical menu in a hamburger button on narrow viewports
keyboardExpectations: Tab moves focus through each link
Enter activates a link
Escape closes the mobile menu and returns focus to the toggle

components.name: nav-toggle
behaviors: Toggles visibility of the primary navigation menu
Updates aria-expanded attribute
keyboardExpectations: Receives focus in tab order
Space or Enter toggles the menu
Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the button

components.name: site-footer
behaviors: Displays copyright information
Appears at the bottom of each page
keyboardExpectations: Receives focus when navigating via Tab
No interactive expectations

components.name: page-title
behaviors: Contains the top‑level heading for the page
keyboardExpectations: Receives focus as part of document reading order
No interactive expectations

components.name: card-grid
behaviors: Responsive grid layout (auto‑fit columns, minimum 260px)
Gap of 1.5rem between cards
keyboardExpectations: Focus moves to each card in DOM order
No interactive expectations on the grid itself

components.name: card
behaviors: Displays an image, title, description, and a link
Hover/focus changes background color
keyboardExpectations: Tab moves focus to the link inside the card
Enter activates the link
The entire card is not a single focusable item

components.name: project-filter
behaviors: Group of checkboxes that filter the project cards
Change event triggers re‑render of the card grid
keyboardExpectations: Each checkbox is focusable via Tab
Space toggles the checkbox state
After a change, focus remains on the changed checkbox

components.name: gallery-lightbox
behaviors: Clicking a tech‑stack icon opens a dialog showing a larger SVG placeholder
Background is semi‑transparent overlay
Dialog can be closed via close button, clicking overlay, or Escape key
keyboardExpectations: When open, focus is trapped inside the dialog
Tab moves focus to the close button
Escape closes the dialog and returns focus to the triggering icon
Clicking the overlay (background) closes the dialog

components.name: contact-form
behaviors: Collects name, email, and message
On submit prevents actual submission, shows a demo toast, then resets the form
keyboardExpectations: Tab moves through each input and the submit button
Enter on a focused submit button submits the form (triggering the demo)
Escape does not close the form (no dialog)

components.name: hero
behaviors: Displays a placeholder SVG and a short tagline
Provides visual introduction to the site
keyboardExpectations: Receives focus as part of reading order
No interactive expectations

components.name: intro
behaviors: Contains a brief introductory paragraph about the site owner
keyboardExpectations: Receives focus as part of reading order
No interactive expectations

components.name: featured-projects
behaviors: Shows three static project cards as examples
keyboardExpectations: Focus moves to each card’s link in turn
No interactive expectations on the section itself

components.name: bio
behaviors: Presents a short biography of the fictional site owner
keyboardExpectations: Receives focus as part of reading order
No interactive expectations

components.name: skills
behaviors: Lists technical skills as an unordered list
keyboardExpectations: Receives focus as part of reading order
No interactive expectations

components.name: post-list
behaviors: Displays blog post entries as cards in a grid
keyboardExpectations: Focus moves to each card’s link in turn
No interactive expectations on the list itself

components.name: tip-list
behaviors: Displays accessibility tips as cards in a grid
keyboardExpectations: Focus moves to each card in turn
No interactive expectations on the list itself

components.name: js-reference
behaviors: Presents a series of short articles on modern JavaScript features
keyboardExpectations: Receives focus as part of reading order
No interactive expectations

components.name: event-list
behaviors: Displays speaking and training events as cards in a grid
keyboardExpectations: Focus moves to each card in turn
No interactive expectations on the list itself

components.name: tech-stack
behaviors: Displays icons representing tools/languages used
Each icon opens a lightbox placeholder on click
keyboardExpectations: Each icon is focusable via Tab
Enter or Space on an icon opens the lightbox
Escape closes the lightbox and returns focus to the icon

components.name: skip-link
behaviors: Provides a mechanism to skip repetitive navigation
Becomes visible when focused
keyboardExpectations: First item in tab order
Enter activates the link, moving focus to #main-content
